sections.title: What this module covers
sections.body: Active Record is the ORM at the heart of every Rails application, and the questions interviewers ask about it reveal whether a candidate understands it as a tool or as a black box. This page covers the Active Record pattern (vs Data Mapper), the full CRUD API and bang method semantics, validations (presence, uniqueness, custom validator objects, and validation contexts), the callback execution order (before_validation through after_commit) and the critical gotcha that after_save fires inside the transaction while after_commit fires after it (use after_commit for external side effects), named scopes vs class methods, the default_scope danger, optimistic locking with :lock_version, and pessimistic locking with with_lock.

sections.title: Key topics and depth markers
sections.body: Topics: orm-fundamentals, crud-lifecycle, validations, callbacks, scopes, locking. Each topic has dedicated Q&A covering the concept, the comparison, the internal mechanics, and the scenario-based questions interviewers use to test production understanding.

sections.title: How interviewers probe this module
sections.body: Interviewers at Rails-focused companies probe these topics by opening with a definition question, then immediately following up with when would you use X vs Y? and what are the gotchas?. The depth marker is always the trade-off and the failure mode — not just the API surface.
